note: Inputs for scripts/fast_test_rank.py. Product facts come from candidates_*.json in this folder. Every value here carries a label and a source.

meta_cpa_benchmark_usd._source: Triple Whale Facebook ads benchmarks, median cost per purchase, Nov 2025 to Oct 2026, 41,000+ brands, read 2026-11-21 (04_reality_and_benchmarks.md, section 10). Established brands, not new stores.

refund_pct_china_shipped.label: ASSUMED
refund_pct_china_shipped.source: CLAUDE.md high scenario used as the base for 10 to 15 day delivery; real refund rate by shipping speed is UNKNOWN (04_reality_and_benchmarks.md)

cost_stress_multiplier.label: ASSUMED
cost_stress_multiplier.source: supplier costs are marketplace search-card prices read during a Black Friday promotion; this checks the product still earns money if the real cost is 20% higher

shopify_first_month.label: ESTIMATED
shopify_first_month.source: Shopify $1/month for the first 3 months (CLAUDE.md section 0; verify at signup)

domain.label: ASSUMED
domain.source: typical .com first-year price; verify at purchase

supplier_app.label: ESTIMATED
supplier_app.source: ordering by hand from a US-stock listing needs no app; Zendrop with 1 to 20 products is $29/month (03_fulfillment_and_money.md)

learning_phase_purchases_per_week.label: VERIFIED
learning_phase_purchases_per_week.source: Meta Business Help Center, about 50 results per ad set per week (04_reality_and_benchmarks.md)

category_rules._note: Which Meta benchmark each product uses. First matching keyword in the product's category wins; otherwise the file default.

ad_budget_usd.label: ASSUMED
ad_budget_usd.source: house plan: $50 a day for 7 days, inside Dhruv's $500 to $1,000 total; creators in 02_youtube_sweep.md test at $25 to $100 a day

average_order_usd.label: ESTIMATED
average_order_usd.source: Triple Whale median Meta AOV, all industries, Nov 2025 to Oct 2026 (04_reality_and_benchmarks.md)

creator_month.label: ESTIMATED
creator_month.source: Austin Rabin's self-reported September 2026 figures for Haven Golf, unaudited (01_video_decode.md section 4)

rule_review._source: Our reading of each product against CLAUDE.md section 2 (out of scope: significant safety risk, high return complexity) using the scouts' ip_safety_flags. Dhruv can overrule.
